summary: The proposed patch addresses an issue with FITSDiff reporting differences in identical files containing variable-length arrays, but it introduces a non-minimal change and may have behavioral regression risks.

issues.description: The change modifies the handling of both 'P' and 'Q' formats in the same condition, which seems unnecessary and could introduce new issues. The patch should be more minimal, targeting only the specific issue with VLAs.
The modification might affect other data types or formats unintentionally, introducing behavioral regressions. More thorough testing is needed to ensure no other formats are impacted negatively.
